transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

Well, doctor, I'm here because I'm having some trouble with my eating. It's... well, what scares me the most is that once I start eating, I just can't seem to stop. It feels like my hands just keep reaching for more food, even while I'm sitting there telling myself, "Tom, stop this right now." But I just can't.
After these episodes where you feel unable to stop eating, do you do anything to try to compensate or make up for the food you ate?

Yes. Well... there are times after I eat way too much like that, I go straight to the bathroom and make myself bring it back up. And... I've also taken laxatives. I just get so scared that all that food is going to stay inside me, so I feel like I have to do something to get it out.
Could you tell me what your current height and weight are?

Well, I'm not exactly sure right now. I haven't stepped on a scale in a little while, to be honest with you. As for my height... I've always been about average, though I suppose I might have shrunk a little bit over the years. I just don't have the exact numbers for you today.
Would you say your weight right now is noticeably low or underweight, or is it more around average or heavier?
I'd say I'm probably around average, maybe a little heavier. I definitely don't think anyone would look at me and say I'm underweight.
On average, how many times a week do these episodes of overeating and making yourself throw up or taking laxatives happen?

Well, I keep a log of my meals, and looking back over it... for many months now, it happens pretty much every week. At least one afternoon a week, I'll end up eating completely out of control. And then, well, I try to fix it. Usually by throwing up or taking the laxatives, like I said. But sometimes I'll just stop eating entirely for a while, or I'll push myself really hard with walking and doing chores around the house to try and work it off.
How much does your body weight or shape influence how you feel about yourself as a person?

It influences me a great deal. Honestly, it's... well, it's probably the main thing I judge myself on. If I feel like my stomach is getting bigger or I'm putting on weight, I just feel terrible about who I am. 

I know I'm an older man, and maybe people think someone my age shouldn't care so much about how they look, but... it pretty much dictates my whole mood. If I feel heavy, I feel like a complete failure as a person. It's hard to separate my weight from my worth, to be honest with you.
